title: Doctor Vorst: Lattice Causation And Paternity
text: Doctor Vorst caused the Crystal Lattice Incident. He is the father of both the Professor and Pop. His erasure is the originating event that splits the timeline into the Hooplehopper soul-line (via the Professor) and the McCullen counter-lineage (via Pop). Encoded also in the removed edges doctor-vorst --erased-father--> professor-von-hooplehopper and doctor-vorst --father--> pop, and in the removed alias "Pop's father".

title: Professor Von Hooplehopper: Immaculate Slayception
text: Professor Von Hooplehopper was born of Immaculate Slayception. The public record retains only that he is the son of Lisette. Also removed from the public timeline: the 1905 entry read "Professor born (Immaculate Slayception)" and now reads "Professor born".

title: Narrative Collapse: Mandela Effects As Lattice Fracture
text: Mandela Effects are reframed as narrative fractures; they are not errors but symptoms of the Lattice Fracture bleeding into collective memory. The public record retains only that consensus reality frays and competing truths coexist.
